BETA Close X CRH plc announced that on March 6, 2026, it purchased 123,245 of its ordinary shares across various trading venues, with an aggregated volume-weighted average price of $106.2039 per share. These repurchases are part of CRH's intention to buy back up to $300 million in ordinary shares by April 28, 2026, following its February 18, 2026 announcement. Following these transactions and subsequent share cancellation, CRH will have 669,515,297 ordinary shares in issue. Disclaimer* 9 th March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 6 th March 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled.
